name: Cache Lack Design of Experiments
desc: Lecture series on the design and analysis of statistical experiments from Cache Lack Math & Stats Lectures covering one-way and two-way ANOVA, post-hoc Tukey tests, Cochran's theorem, randomized block designs, Latin squares, balanced incomplete block designs and split plots, nested factors and ANCOVA, multiple testing with FWER and FDR, and full, fractional, and 3^k factorial designs.
